énerver.gloss: to annoy, to irritate; (s'énerver) to get worked up

meanings.en: to annoy, to get on someone's nerves
meanings.note: Ça m'énerve! = that annoys me!. Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'to annoy'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'énervé').

meanings.en: s'énerver = to get angry, to lose one's temper
meanings.note: ne t'énerve pas = don't get worked up

examples.trans: Julie is getting worked up on the set.
